body:
## Idea: interactive demo mode on the landing page — "Try the demo" with mock data

**Goal:** help RT win its first paying customers. A landing-page button opens a **fully clickable landlord dashboard seeded with mock data** — mock applicants, AI scores, downloadable mock reports, comparison view — everything a landlord does, **non-persistent** (refresh/reset wipes it). No signup required to enter.

**Status:** research complete (2026-08-18) — implementation deferred; brief `righttenantry-demo-mode` when picked up.

---

### Does it improve conversions? (research, 2026-08-18)

| Metric | Finding | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Website MQL conversion | **+63%** (1.1% → 1.8%) for demo-engaged visitors | [HockeyStack Labs](https://www.hockeystack.com/lab-blog-posts/do-interactive-demos-work) — 24 B2B SaaS, anonymized, not vendor-sponsored |
| MQL → SQL | **1.5×** better for demo-engaged | HockeyStack |
| Sales cycle | **23% faster** close | HockeyStack |
| Demo engagement (ungated) | **19.4%** of visitors (vs 9.2% gated, 15.5% partial-gate) | [Storylane — 535,763 sessions](https://www.storylane.io/plot/should-you-gate-your-interactive-demos) |
| Demo length | Top-10% demos: **64% completion @ ~9 steps**; 37-step demos: 1.4% | [Storylane](https://www.storylane.io/plot/should-you-gate-your-interactive-demos) |
| Placement | First fold / navbar ≫ below fold; button vs inline ≈ equal (23–26% CTR) | Storylane — 130k sessions |

**Caveats:** conversion datasets are mid-market B2B (ACV $15–80K, sales-call funnels); RT is self-serve SMB where the effect is likely *stronger* (the demo effectively IS the trial). Storylane/Navattic sell demo tools (vendor bias); HockeyStack is the independent set. **The empty-room caveat: weak mock data = weak demo — the fixtures ARE the product marketing.**

### Verdict: worth it — Option B (client-side mock adapter)

| Option | Cost | Risk | Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| A. Session-scoped backend sandbox (seeded demo landlord, TTL-swept writes) | Big: middleware, seeding, write partition, sweeper, AI-cost abuse caps | New attack surface on audit-hardened routes | Later, if demo proves out |
| **B. Client-side mock adapter** ⭐ | **Small: client-only job (~1–2 stories)** | ~Zero: no backend, no auth bypass, no AI spend, mock data is GDPR-neutral | **Recommended** |
| C. Isolated demo deployment (demo.righttenantry.ie, nightly reset) | Second deploy pipeline forever | AI-cost caps still needed | Overkill pre-first-customer |
| D. Vendor tool (Navattic/Storylane, ~$500+/mo) | Guided rails only | Fails "click around, do everything" | No |

### Design (Option B)

The client is a Gleam/Lustre SPA with a clean `client/src/api/` layer — the seam already exists:

1. **Mock adapter** — a demo-flagged build swaps `api/` calls for an **in-memory store** seeded with fixture JSON. Create/edit/archive vacancy, compare applicants, view scores all work in local SPA state. Non-persistent by construction (refresh = reset; "reset demo" button is free).
2. **Mock reports/downloads** — pre-bake PDFs ONCE through the real Typst pipeline from the same fixtures, ship as static assets. Real report, fake applicant, zero per-call AI cost. AI score content: canned but real-shaped JSON.
3. **Demo chrome** — banner ("Demo — nothing is saved"), reset button, and **in-demo CTA**: "Start your real vacancy →" shown right after the visitor downloads a mock report (ungated entry for engagement; ask at the moment of felt value).
4. **Drift guard** — fixtures typed against `shared/` decoders so the mock can't silently rot as the real API evolves (compile-time + `make test` conformance).
5. **Analytics** — PostHog demo-flagged events (no identify, no PII; existing consent gate) to learn which surfaces sell.
6. **Placement** — first-fold "Try the demo" CTA on the landing page (button form is fine per CTR parity data).

### Security/compliance notes (from the 2026-08-18 audit context)

- Mock data only — no real PII ever enters the demo path.
- No changes to session-gated landlord routes; demo mode is a client build-flag, not a new backend surface.
- Stripe/payment, email, AI scoring endpoints are never invoked from demo mode.

### Next step when picked up

Gru briefs `righttenantry-demo-mode` (spec + implementation); the demo-flow design + mock-data story + CTA placement get a **lavish browser review before any code PR**.
